kickoff.text: And we're UNDERWAY! I have a FEELING about this one!
Kick off! My hands are already shaking!
Here we go! I'll never be the same man again!
We're off! Hold on to your hats!

goal_you.text: GOAL! Oh my WORD, GOAL! I can't BREATHE!
It's IN! It's IN! Somebody hold me!
GOAL! In Europe we'd call that a miracle!
I have NEVER seen anything like that! GOAL!
The net is BULGING! The beauty of it!

goal_cpu.text: The MACHINE scores! Is that even allowed?!
Oh no, no, no! The CPU has scored!
A robot! A ROBOT has scored!
Cruel, cruel football! I am devastated!
It's in! I want to speak to a manager!

equaliser.text: AND IT'S LEVEL! I don't believe it!
Back on terms! My poor heart!

rout_you.text: This isn't football, it's a MASSACRE!
Running riot! Show NO mercy, lad!
A thrashing! I shall need to lie down!

rout_cpu.text: A catastrophe! The machine is toying with us!
The humiliation! My mother is watching!

save.text: What a SAVE! How is that even HUMAN?!
Kept out! I've lost a year of my life!
STOPPED! That's robbery in broad daylight!
A hand! A single, glorious hand!

shot.text: He's had a go! Why not!

slide.text: That is a TACKLE! Somebody's getting a letter!
Studs up! Well, no studs, but the spirit!
Stolen right off his toe! Disgraceful!
Bone-rattling! You'd never see that at Wembley!

shito_you.text: He's taken the SHITOR! I have no idea what happens next!
The ball is GLOWING! Is that legal?!
He's armed the ball! Heaven help the defenders!
Shitor! My blood pressure is up!

shito_burn.text: IT'S GONE THROUGH THEM! They're on FIRE!
BURNED them! Never seen that in my LIFE!
Through one! Through TWO! THREE! Not at the Emirates!

shito_cpu.text: The CPU has set the ball alight! Brace!
The machine has the shitor! RUN, you fools!
A fireball! I want to go home!

dumsor_you.text: DOOMSOR! The lights are out! They've STOPPED!
Total darkness! The whole team's turned to stone!
The power cut to END all power cuts!
Not a muscle! Is this a museum?!

dumsor_cpu.text: They've cut the lights! My lads are statues!
Doomsor! The dirtiest trick in football! I LOVE it!
I can't see! Is somebody there?!
We're frozen solid! Can't anyone move?!

trotro_you.text: Here comes the trotro! He's coming THROUGH!
He's boarded a minibus! Through the defence!
Beep beep! Out of the WAY!

trotro_cpu.text: The machine's on a trotro! DIVE!
He's FLATTENED the lot of them!
They've run us over! Actually run us over!

sankofa_you.text: THE GOAL HAS BEEN UNSCORED! This is witchcraft!
Wait. It was a goal, and now it ISN'T a goal?!
He's turned back time! I demand an inquiry!
They can't DO that! They've just DONE that!
Wiped off the scoreboard! I'm hallucinating!

sankofa_cpu.text: They've reversed our goal! It was OURS!
Sunkofa! They've taken it back! Our beautiful goal!
I SAW it go in! And now it hasn't happened!
Daylight robbery! Time itself has been robbed!

sankofa_back.text: Going back to fetch it! Sunkofa!

obolo.text: He's gone HUGE! The man is a house!
Obolo! The size of a bus! Nobody can move him!

magnet.text: The ball is glued to his boot! It's a magnet!
The ball flew straight to his feet! Spooky!

azonto.text: He's DANCING past them! Azonto! Give him a medal!
The FOOTWORK! They can't touch him!
He's showboating and nobody can stop it!

juju.text: WHAT IS HAPPENING?! BALLS, plural, from the CPU! This is not in ANY rulebook!
JUJU! I have NEVER seen the like! Check the rules!
BALLS everywhere! They're purple! The CPU has summoned something!
NO! The machine has gone to the village elders! WITCHCRAFT!
Three seconds left, and a supernatural rabbit! I need a priest!

juju_goal.text: IT'S IN! Another one! They cannot MISS!
And ANOTHER! This isn't football, it's a SEANCE!
Why do they keep going in?!

last10.text: Ten seconds left! Every nerve is on fire!
I can't watch! I can't NOT watch!
The clock is ticking! ANYTHING could happen!

golden.text: Level at full time! Golden goal! I've gone cold!
Sudden death! I need to sit down!
Golden goal! The pure, unfiltered DRAMA!

win.text: A famous victory! They'll talk about this for a generation!
FULL TIME! You've won it! I'm openly WEEPING!
It's over! And you won it! I don't know where to look!
Magnificent! And they said it couldn't be done!

win_big.text: That wasn't a match, it was a public execution!
A complete rout! Someone hug the poor CPU!
Demolished! I need a dark room!

loss.text: It's over. We've lost to a computer. My career is finished.
Full time. The machine goes home happy. I can't talk about it.
They've beaten us! I'll never forgive myself!
Well. That's that. Cruel, cruel game.

draw.text: A draw. I've aged ten years for nothing.
All square! I feel like I've been through a war!

juju_loss.text: THEY'VE WON IT! BY WITCHCRAFT! I'm writing to the FA!
ROBBED! By the supernatural! There's no defence against that!
It was five-one! FIVE-ONE! This match was haunted!
I'm calling ALL of the authorities!
